definition: [ רָפַק ] verb Hithpa`el support oneself, lean (Ethiopic reclinare, accumbere ad mensam; compare Arabic be gentle, bind camel's arm to prevent going quickly ; , Late Hebrew מַרְפַּק , Jewish-Aramaic מַרְפְּקָא , elbow ); — Participle feminine מִתְרַפֶּקֶת Song 8:5 (with עַל person). רפשׂ see רפס . above
